sample_policy.selection: deterministic hash(condition_id, tx_hash, log_index); never target value

split_policy.train: timestamp < train_end-300 and target label_end < train_end
split_policy.dev: timestamp >= train_end+300 and timestamp < dev_end-300 and target label_end < dev_end

census.spearman: deterministic rank sample; ranks are computed before correlation
census.deciles: deterministic bucket sample; buckets are TRAIN feature deciles
census.full_support: full TRAIN rows via wide aggregate per family

redundancy.clustering: connected components under absolute Spearman threshold
redundancy.representative: highest median absolute TRAIN Spearman across supported targets; lexical tie-break
redundancy.missing_value_handling: pairwise complete rank correlation; minimum 100 observations

dev_selection.concentration_gate: feature-target sample specific; max single-market share <= 0.50
dev_selection.stability_statistic: TRAIN Spearman and DEV Spearman must have the same non-zero sign; DEV Pearson is retained as a secondary diagnostic.

promotion_gate.effect_sign_persistence: Using the TRAIN median feature threshold, the TRAIN and DEV directional-response differences must both be finite, non-zero, and have the same sign.
promotion_gate.model_improvement: For model-eligible targets, the DEV-selected model must be non-baseline and strictly improve the primary DEV metric versus persistence/majority. Atlas-only targets cannot receive a promoted candidate label.
promotion_gate.no_rescue: Failure of any promotion gate leaves the row DISCOVERY_ONLY; it does not trigger alternate horizons, thresholds, features or models.

model_eligibility.regression_selection: highest DEV MAE improvement versus persistence baseline
model_eligibility.classification_selection: lowest DEV multiclass Brier score, then highest accuracy
model_eligibility.own_history_baseline: Always evaluated for regression targets using price_change_30 for price-change targets and realised_vol_30 for realised-movement targets, even when that feature is not shortlisted.

shortlist_freeze_requirement: Stage output must be committed and hash-bound before any HOLDOUT query.
